description: Resupply points on Te Araroa, researched by hand. The trust's KMZ contains no towns or shops at all, so these fill the gap the official data leaves. Positions are OpenStreetMap geocodes of the settlement or the named business; the build projects each onto the route to get its trail km and how far off-trail it sits. Where a town is reached from a named point on the trail rather than by the route's nearest approach, accessFromKm gives the trail km you leave at and accessRoadKm the road distance from there.
sources: https://teararoanobo.net/ (regional guides: Northland, Auckland, Waikato, Whanganui, Manawatu, Wellington, Marlborough-Tasman, Canterbury, Otago, Southland)

points.name: Ahipara
points.notes: Ahipara Superette: groceries and post shop. Cafe closes 2pm. First resupply after Cape Reinga.

points.name: Kaitaia
points.notes: Pak'nSave, Bells Produce, two bulk-food shops. 14 km inland from Ahipara; hitch or bus.

points.name: Mangamuka Bridge Dairy
points.notes: Dairy and takeaways on SH1, Mon-Fri 7am-6pm. Phone charging. Snacks only.

points.name: Kerikeri
points.notes: New World and Countdown. Full resupply, hostels.

points.name: Paihia
points.notes: Countdown Central plus a larger Countdown at Waitangi. Four Square on Williams Rd.

points.name: Opua
points.notes: Small general store, expensive. Ferry point.

points.name: Whananaki
points.notes: Whananaki Superette: limited supplies. Holiday park with a hut for TA walkers.

points.name: Matapouri
points.notes: Small general store.

points.name: Ngunguru
points.notes: Four Square dairy and takeaway, plus cafes. Limited and expensive.

points.name: Whangarei
points.notes: Countdown and Woolworths, hostels, buses. Inland from the Heads; a detour, not on route. Leave at the Whangarei Heads / Marsden Point crossing.

points.name: Ruakaka
points.notes: FreshChoice supermarket and takeaways.

points.name: Waipu
points.notes: Four Square, cafes, hotel with budget rooms. Camp Waipu Cove has a dairy.

points.name: Mangawhai Heads
points.notes: Four Square at 3 Wood St. Holiday park.

points.name: Mangawhai
points.notes: New World 1 km north of the village, plus a Four Square.

points.name: Warkworth
points.notes: Countdown, New World and a Bin Inn. About 6 km off trail. Short detour off the Dome Valley section.

points.name: Pakiri Beach Holiday Park
points.notes: Camp store: food, drinks, milk, bread. 9am-5pm summer only.

points.name: Puhoi
points.notes: General store 7am-7pm, historic pub, three cafes.

points.name: Orewa
points.notes: New World and Countdown, cafes, outdoor shops.

points.name: Silverdale
points.notes: Silverdale Centre: Woolworths, Macpac, Kathmandu, ATMs.

points.name: Browns Bay
points.notes: New World and Countdown.

points.name: Devonport
points.notes: New World. Ferry to the city.

points.name: Auckland CBD
points.notes: Full resupply and gear replacement. Metro supermarkets are smaller than suburban ones.

points.name: Mangere Bridge
points.notes: FreshChoice, slightly off trail.

points.name: Papakura
points.notes: Pak'nSave, Countdown, New World.

points.name: Mercer
points.notes: Service centre with food outlets; motel with camping.

points.name: Huntly
points.notes: Woolworths, about 1 km off trail.

points.name: Ngaruawahia
points.notes: New World and cafes.

points.name: Hamilton
points.notes: Pak'nSave, Woolworths, Trek N Travel outdoor store. Full gear replacement.

points.name: Whatawhata
points.notes: Petrol station store, gastro pub and village cafe.

points.name: Waitomo
points.notes: Waitomo Village Store 7am-7pm, expensive. Cafes and restaurants.

points.name: Te Kuiti
points.notes: New World and SuperValue.

points.name: Taumarunui
points.notes: New World at the west end. Seriously Outdoors for gear; canoe hire.

points.name: Owhango
points.notes: Blue Hill Cafe, 8am-2pm.

points.name: Whakapapa Village
points.notes: Camp store carries little more than ice blocks and muesli bars. Not a resupply.

points.name: National Park (Waimarino)
points.notes: Four Square, well stocked with dehydrated meals and gas. First real shop since Whanganui.

points.name: Whakahoro
points.notes: Blue Duck Cafe 8am-3pm Thu-Mon. DoC campsite. Blue Duck Station does meals and accommodation.

points.name: Pipiriki
points.notes: Minimal cafe and shop at the campground. Jetboat transfers.

points.name: Matahiwi
points.notes: Matahiwi Gallery and Cafe: coffee, cold drinks, local knowledge.

points.name: Whanganui
points.notes: New World, Countdown, Pak'nSave. Kathmandu; Wilsons Hunting and Outdoors stores bounce boxes.

points.name: Bulls
points.notes: Four Square at 114 Bridge St, plus takeaways.

points.name: Feilding
points.notes: New World, Bin Inn. Friday farmers market. 2-3 km off trail.

points.name: Palmerston North
points.notes: Pak'nSave, Woolworths, New World, Bin Inn. Full resupply.

points.name: Bunnythorpe
points.notes: Dairy, takeaway bar and toilets, on trail.

points.name: Levin
points.notes: Pak'nSave, New World, Countdown. About 9 km off trail. Leave at Poads Rd.

points.name: Waikanae
points.notes: Countdown and New World near the town centre. No backpackers.

points.name: Paraparaumu Beach
points.notes: Cafes, shops and a small supermarket.

points.name: Paekakariki
points.notes: Dairy/grocery, two fruit and vegetable shops, cafes and a pub.

points.name: Porirua
points.notes: New World, Woolworths and Pak'nSave together, 150 m off trail.

points.name: Wellington
points.notes: Capital: full resupply, gear stores, bulk-food refilleries. End of the North Island.

points.name: Picton
points.notes: Four Square and FreshChoice on High St. Ferry arrival; off the walking route. Ferry landing; walk resumes at Ship Cove by water taxi.

points.name: Havelock
points.notes: Small Four Square, post office, cafes. Havelock Holiday Park accepts food parcels.

points.name: Nelson
points.notes: Supermarkets, outdoor shops, backpackers. About 29 km off trail from Hacket car park. Leave at the Hacket car park, start of the Richmond Alpine Track.

points.name: St Arnaud
points.notes: General store and 24 hr NPD station; DoC centre sells gas and dehydrated meals. Alpine Lodge holds parcels ($15-30). Expensive.

points.name: Hanmer Springs
points.notes: Four Square, hot pools, backpackers. About 55 km off trail from Boyle; shuttle or hitch. Leave at Boyle Village on SH7; shuttle or hitch.

points.name: Boyle Village
points.notes: No shop. Boyle River Outdoor Education Centre holds resupply boxes, sells basic food, beds $50.

points.name: Arthur's Pass
points.notes: Arthur's Pass Cafe and Store: limited, expensive groceries. DoC centre sells gas. Mountain House holds boxes.

points.name: Lake Coleridge Village
points.notes: No shops. Powerhouse Lodge holds bounce boxes and has tent sites.

points.name: Methven
points.notes: Two supermarkets, Alpine Sports for dehydrated meals and gas. Snow Denn Lodge holds boxes ($5). Shuttle from Rakaia. Leave at the Rakaia River; the river is a no-ford hazard zone, shuttle required.

points.name: Geraldine
points.notes: Supermarket and accommodation. About 70 km from the Rangitata via Methven; community shuttle $24. Leave at the Rangitata River; community shuttle $24, book two days ahead.

points.name: Peel Forest
points.notes: DoC Peel Forest camp and a small store. Homestay offers transport to the trailhead. Leave at the Rangitata River.

points.name: Mesopotamia Station
points.notes: Historic station near the Rangitata; holds food parcels. Leave at the Rangitata River crossing.

points.name: Mt Potts Lodge
points.notes: Cafe and restaurant, closed Tue/Wed, book meals ahead. Has held food parcels; check first. Leave at the Rangitata River crossing.

points.name: Lake Tekapo
points.notes: Large Four Square, cafes. Tailormade Backpackers and Bespoke Bikes receive bounce boxes.

points.name: Twizel
points.notes: Two Four Squares, Southern Alps Outdoors for gas. High Country Lodge holds parcels.

points.name: Lake Hawea
points.notes: Sailz general store with cafe, open to 9pm; FreshChoice on Bodkin St; Hawea Hotel for pub food.

points.name: Albert Town
points.notes: Small Four Square and a patisserie, a short detour off trail.

points.name: Wanaka
points.notes: New World, Four Square, Mediterranean Market for bulk, Macpac. Full resupply.

points.name: Arrowtown
points.notes: Small supermarket and a Night'n Day; limited and expensive. Hourly bus to Queenstown.

points.name: Frankton
points.notes: Pak'nSave, New World, Woolworths. Cheapest resupply in the Queenstown basin.

points.name: Queenstown
points.notes: FreshChoice, Four Square, outdoor stores. Full gear replacement.

points.name: Glenorchy
points.notes: Glenorchy Hotel general store. About 1.5 hr drive from the Greenstone car park. Leave at the Greenstone car park.

points.name: Te Anau
points.notes: Four Square and FreshChoice, Outside Sports. 28-35 km off trail from SH94; shuttle or hitch. Leave at the SH94 / Princhester junction (The Key).

points.name: Mossburn
points.notes: Four Square at 37 Devon St. About 20 km from the Princhester/SH94 junction. Leave at the SH94 / Princhester junction (The Key).

points.name: The Key (Princhester)
points.notes: Sprig and Thistle coffee caravan at the SH94 junction, Tue-Fri 7am-3pm, Sat 8am-2pm.

points.name: Nightcaps
points.notes: Four Square and a pub. About 9-16 km east of the trail near Birchwood. Leave near Birchwood.

points.name: Otautau
points.notes: Small supermarket, hotels with backpacker beds. About 12-16 km east of Merrivale Rd. Leave at Merrivale Rd.

points.name: Tuatapere
points.notes: Small supermarket, several lodges. About 26 km west of Merrivale Rd. Leave at Merrivale Rd.

points.name: Colac Bay
points.notes: Colac Bay Bakehouse and Cafe with a camping ground; shop operating.

points.name: Riverton
points.notes: FreshChoice/SuperValue on Palmerston St, cafes and takeaways. Holiday park.

points.name: Otatara
points.notes: Four Square, on the way into Invercargill.

points.name: Invercargill
points.notes: Pak'nSave, New World, Woolworths, Macpac and Kathmandu. Last full resupply.

points.name: Bluff
points.notes: Four Square. Trail end at Stirling Point.
